newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco police arrest 11 Europeans on drugs charges.
newsitem.headline: Morocco police arrest 11 Europeans on drugs charges.

text.p: Morocco's anti-drug police have arrested 11 suspected European drug traffickers and seized more than two tonnes of cannabis resin in separate raids in northern Morocco, police said on Thursday.
A police statement quoted by the official MAP news agency said the arrests were made earlier this week after the seizure of 2.15 tonnes of hashish in the northern port of Tangier.
The suspected traffickers -- six Spaniards, four Germans and a French national -- will appear before a criminal court next week, the statement said.
Police did not give the names of those arrested.
Morocco launched earlier this year a nationwide campaign against drug trafficking in which more than 100 foreign nationals were arrested for their involvemnt in cannabis smuggling, officials said.
